correctness.rationale: Every generating vertex is exposed by its indicator color and is a vertex of that simplex; all pairs have exactly |S△T|+2[σ≠τ] squared distance in the full one-hot affine hyperplane. Strict convexity excludes nonvertex endpoints, equality forces complementary upper ideals and distinct colors. Dual upper ideals are precisely unions of comparability components; counts of suffix-compatible extensions factor as e(P|I)e(P|I^c). The trivial pair gives k(k−1), proper component-union pairs give a(I)^2/2; the k=1 chain boundary is separate. Direct exact independent enumeration covered 407 naturally labeled posets up to size five, 2,996,310 vertex-pair comparisons; mathematical proof is unrestricted.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical symmetric Euclidean realization of all alternative indicator coordinates from a newly studied high-dimensional poset-polytope construction; the numerical diameter alone is easy but the complete equality graph is not just its numeric bound. Its bipartite-block decomposition and precise sizes e(P|I)e(P|I^c) detect and quantify all comparability-component separations; for connected posets there are k(k−1) pairs, while antichains exhibit a reciprocal-binomial factorial identity. This gives a natural complete extremal classification in a potentially factorial-dimensional family. It neither repackages a different metric nor claims an unsupported downstream theorem.
